movies.overview: The drug-induced utopias of four Coney Island residents are shattered when their addictions run deep.
movies.title: Requiem for a Dream

movies.overview: At the height of the Vietnam war, Captain Benjamin Willard is sent on a dangerous mission that, officially, "does not exist, nor will it ever exist." His goal is to locate - and eliminate - a mysterious Green Beret Colonel named Walter Kurtz, who has been leading his personal army on illegal guerrilla missions into enemy territory.
movies.title: Apocalypse Now
movies.tagline: This is the end...

movies.overview: Jack Torrance accepts a caretaker job at the Overlook Hotel, where he, along with his wife Wendy and their son Danny, must live isolated from the rest of the world for the winter. But they aren't prepared for the madness that lurks within.
movies.title: The Shining
movies.tagline: A masterpiece of modern horror.

movies.overview: Suffering from insomnia, disturbed loner Travis Bickle takes a job as a New York City cabbie, haunting the streets nightly, growing increasingly detached from reality as he dreams of cleaning up the filthy city.
movies.title: Taxi Driver
movies.tagline: On every street in every city in this country, there's a nobody who dreams of being somebody. He's a lonely forgotten man desperate to prove that he's alive.

movies.overview: Three steelworkers enlist in the army and are sent to Vietnam, one leaving behind a rushed marriage, the others a shared love. What they encounter during the war changes their lives forever.
movies.title: The Deer Hunter
movies.tagline: One of the most important and powerful films of all time!

movies.overview: With no clue how he came to be imprisoned, drugged and tortured for 15 years, a desperate man seeks revenge on his captors.
movies.title: Oldboy
movies.tagline: 15 years of imprisonment, five days of vengeance.

movies.overview: Two homicide detectives are on a desperate hunt for a serial killer whose crimes are based on the "seven deadly sins" in this dark and haunting film that takes viewers from the tortured remains of one victim to the next. The seasoned Det. Somerset researches each sin in an effort to get inside the killer's mind, while his novice partner, Mills, scoffs at his efforts to unravel the case.
movies.title: Se7en
movies.tagline: Gluttony. Greed. Sloth. Envy. Wrath. Pride. Lust.

movies.overview: After getting a green card in exchange for assassinating a Cuban government official, Tony Montana stakes a claim on the drug trade in Miami. Viciously murdering anyone who stands in his way, Tony eventually becomes the biggest drug lord in the state, controlling nearly all the cocaine that comes through Miami. But increased pressure from the police, wars with Colombian drug cartels and his own drug-fueled paranoia serve to fuel the flames of his eventual downfall.
movies.title: Scarface
movies.tagline: He loved the American Dream. With a vengeance.

movies.overview: A committed dancer struggles to maintain her sanity after winning the lead role in a production of Tchaikovsky's "Swan Lake".
movies.title: Black Swan
movies.tagline: The only person standing in your way is you.

movies.overview: Billy Hayes is caught attempting to smuggle drugs out of Turkey. The Turkish courts decide to make an example of him, sentencing him to more than 30 years in prison. Hayes has two opportunities for release: the appeals made by his lawyer, his family, and the American government, or the "Midnight Express".
movies.title: Midnight Express
movies.tagline: Walk into the incredible true experience of Billy Hayes. And bring all the courage you can.

movies.overview: A teacher lives a lonely life, all the while struggling over his son’s custody. His life slowly gets better as he finds love and receives good news from his son, but his new luck is about to be brutally shattered by an innocent little lie.
movies.title: The Hunt
movies.tagline: The lie is spreading.

movies.overview: A New York stockbroker refuses to cooperate in a large securities fraud case involving corruption on Wall Street, corporate banking world and mob infiltration. Based on Jordan Belfort's autobiography.
movies.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
movies.tagline: Earn. Spend. Party.

movies.overview: After returning home from the Vietnam War, veteran Jacob Singer struggles to maintain his sanity. Plagued by hallucinations and flashbacks, Singer rapidly falls apart as the world and people around him morph and twist into disturbing images. His girlfriend, Jezzie, and ex-wife, Sarah, try to help, but to little avail. Even Singer's chiropractor friend, Louis, fails to reach him as he descends into madness.
movies.title: Jacob's Ladder
movies.tagline: The most frightening thing about Jacob Singer's nightmare is that he isn't dreaming.

movies.overview: A woman’s lover and her ex-boyfriend take justice into their own hands after she becomes the victim of a rapist. Because some acts can’t be undone. Because man is an animal. Because the desire for vengeance is a natural impulse. Because most crimes remain unpunished.
movies.title: Irreversible
movies.tagline: Time destroys everything.

movies.overview: Intent on seeing the Cahulawassee River before it's turned into one huge lake, outdoor fanatic Lewis Medlock takes his friends on a river-rafting trip they'll never forget into the dangerous American back-country.
movies.title: Deliverance
movies.tagline: What did happen on the Cahulawassee River?

movies.overview: The invasion of a village in Belarus by German forces sends young Florya into the forest to join the weary Resistance fighters, against his family's wishes. There he meets a girl, Glasha, who accompanies him back to his village. On returning home, Florya finds his family and fellow peasants massacred. His continued survival amidst the brutal debris of war becomes increasingly nightmarish, a battle between despair and hope.
movies.title: Come and See
movies.tagline: The cruelest side of war.

movies.overview: While investigating a young nun's rape, a corrupt New York City police detective, with a serious drug and gambling addiction, tries to change his ways and find forgiveness.
movies.title: Bad Lieutenant
movies.tagline: Gambler. Thief. Junkie. Killer. Cop.

movies.overview: An Irish rogue uses his cunning and wit to work his way up the social classes of 18th century England, transforming himself from the humble Redmond Barry into the noble Barry Lyndon.
movies.title: Barry Lyndon
movies.tagline: At long last Redmond Barry became a gentleman -- and that was his tragedy.

movies.overview: Heroin addict Mark Renton stumbles through bad ideas and sobriety attempts with his unreliable friends --Sick Boy, Begbie, Spud and Tommy. He also has an underage girlfriend, Diane, along for the ride. After cleaning up and moving from Edinburgh to London, Mark finds he can't escape the life he left behind as Begbie and Sick Boy come knocking.
movies.title: Trainspotting
movies.tagline: Choose life.

movies.overview: An insurance investigator visits a small town while looking into the strange disappearance of a popular horror novelist. He soon finds that the impact of the author’s books is far more than inspirational.
movies.title: In the Mouth of Madness
movies.tagline: Lived any good books lately?

movies.overview: Trevor, an insomniac lathe operator, experiences unusual occurrences at work and home. A strange man follows him everywhere, but no one else seems to notice him.
movies.title: The Machinist
movies.tagline: How do you wake up from a nightmare if you’re not asleep?

movies.overview: A group of male friends become obsessed with five mysterious sisters who are sheltered by their strict, religious parents.
movies.title: The Virgin Suicides
movies.tagline: Beautiful, mysterious, haunting, invariably fatal. Just like life.

movies.overview: Ruthless silver miner, turned oil prospector, Daniel Plainview, moves to oil-rich California. Using his son to project a trustworthy, family-man image, Plainview cons local landowners into selling him their valuable properties for a pittance. However, local preacher Eli Sunday suspects Plainview's motives and intentions, starting a slow-burning feud that threatens both their lives.
movies.title: There Will Be Blood
movies.tagline: There will be greed. There will be vengeance.

movies.overview: The life of boxer Jake LaMotta, whose violence and temper that led him to the top in the ring destroyed his life outside of it.
movies.title: Raging Bull
movies.tagline: I don’t go down for nobody.

movies.overview: A ticking-time-bomb insomniac and a slippery soap salesman channel primal male aggression into a shocking new form of therapy. Their concept catches on, with underground "fight clubs" forming in every town, until an eccentric gets in the way and ignites an out-of-control spiral toward oblivion.
movies.title: Fight Club
movies.tagline: Mischief. Mayhem. Soap.

movies.overview: During the 1980s, a failed stand-up comedian is driven insane and turns to a life of crime and chaos in Gotham City while becoming an infamous psychopathic crime figure.
movies.title: Joker
movies.tagline: Put on a happy face.

movies.overview: A young couple, Rosemary and Guy, moves into an infamous New York apartment building, known by frightening legends and mysterious events, with the purpose of starting a family.
movies.title: Rosemary's Baby
movies.tagline: Pray for Rosemary's Baby.

movies.overview: In a near-future Britain, young Alexander DeLarge and his pals get their kicks beating and raping anyone they please. When not destroying the lives of others, Alex swoons to the music of Beethoven. The state, eager to crack down on juvenile crime, gives an incarcerated Alex the option to undergo an invasive procedure that'll rob him of all personal agency. In a time when conscience is a commodity, can Alex change his tune?
movies.title: A Clockwork Orange
movies.tagline: Being the adventures of a young man whose principal interests are rape, ultra-violence and Beethoven.

movies.overview: Two psychotic young men take a mother, father, and son hostage in their vacation cabin and force them to play sadistic "games" with one another for their own amusement.
movies.title: Funny Games

movies.overview: An ordinary man frustrated with the various flaws he sees in society begins to psychotically and violently lash out against them.
movies.title: Falling Down
movies.tagline: The adventures of an ordinary man at war with the everyday world.

movies.overview: On the run after committing murder, an accountant encounters a strange Native American man who prepares him for his journey into the spiritual world.
movies.title: Dead Man
movies.tagline: It is preferable not to travel with a dead man.

movies.overview: A down-and-out Brooklyn detective is hired to track down a singer on an odyssey that will take him through the desperate streets of Harlem, the smoke-filled jazz clubs of New Orleans, and the swamps of Louisiana and its seedy underworld of voodoo.
movies.title: Angel Heart
movies.tagline: It will scare you to your very soul.

movies.overview: Ben Sanderson, an alcoholic Hollywood screenwriter who lost everything because of his drinking, arrives in Las Vegas to drink himself to death. There, he meets and forms an uneasy friendship and non-interference pact with prostitute Sera.
movies.title: Leaving Las Vegas
movies.tagline: I love you... The way you are.

movies.overview: Withdrawn and sensitive teenager Carrie White faces bullying from classmates and abuse from her fanatically pious mother. When she begins to suspect that she has supernatural powers, things take a dark and violent turn.
movies.title: Carrie
movies.tagline: If you've got a taste for terror… take Carrie to the prom.

movies.overview: A few decades after the destruction of the Inca Empire, a Spanish expedition led by the infamous Aguirre leaves the mountains of Peru and goes down the Amazon River in search of the lost city of El Dorado. When great difficulties arise, Aguirre’s men start to wonder whether their quest will lead them to prosperity or certain death.
movies.title: Aguirre, the Wrath of God
movies.tagline: A breathtaking journey into the heart of darkness.

movies.overview: A high school basketball player’s life turns upside down after free-falling into the harrowing world of drug addiction.
movies.title: The Basketball Diaries
movies.tagline: The true story of the death of innocence and the birth of an artist.

movies.overview: Selma, a Czech immigrant on the verge of blindness, struggles to make ends meet for herself and her son, who has inherited the same genetic disorder and will suffer the same fate without an expensive operation. When life gets too difficult, Selma learns to cope through her love of musicals, dreaming up little numbers to the rhythmic beats of her surroundings.
movies.title: Dancer in the Dark
movies.tagline: In a world of shadows, she found the light of life.

movies.overview: In the final months of World War II, 14-year-old Seita and his sister Setsuko are orphaned when their mother is killed during an air raid in Kobe, Japan. After a falling out with their aunt, they move into an abandoned bomb shelter. With no surviving relatives and their emergency rations depleted, Seita and Setsuko struggle to survive.
movies.title: Grave of the Fireflies
movies.tagline: Why do fireflies have to die so soon?

movies.overview: A drug pusher grows increasingly desperate after a botched deal leaves him with a large debt to a ruthless drug lord.
movies.title: Pusher
movies.tagline: You don't have a chance. Seize it!

movies.overview: After a personal tragedy, Sarah joins her friends on a caving expedition in the Appalachian Mountains. But when a rockfall traps them deep underground, their adventure turns into a nightmare. As they search for a way out, the group discovers they are not alone—lurking in the darkness are savage, cave-dwelling creatures. With rising tension and dwindling trust, the women must fight to survive against both the predators and each other.
movies.title: The Descent
movies.tagline: Scream your last breath.

movies.original_title: We Need to Talk About Kevin
movies.overview: After her son Kevin commits a horrific act, troubled mother Eva reflects on her complicated relationship with her disturbed son as he grew from a toddler into a teenager.
movies.title: We Need to Talk About Kevin
movies.tagline: This conversation is long overdue.

movies.overview: The true story of Henry Hill, a half-Irish, half-Sicilian Brooklyn kid who is adopted by neighbourhood gangsters at an early age and climbs the ranks of a Mafia family under the guidance of Jimmy Conway.
movies.title: GoodFellas
movies.tagline: Three decades of life in the mafia.

movies.overview: World War II soldier-turned-U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels investigates the disappearance of a patient from a hospital for the criminally insane, but his efforts are compromised by troubling visions and a mysterious doctor.
movies.title: Shutter Island
movies.tagline: Someone is missing.

movies.overview: A pragmatic U.S. Marine observes the dehumanizing effects the U.S.-Vietnam War has on his fellow recruits from their brutal boot camp training to the bloody street fighting in Hue.
movies.title: Full Metal Jacket
movies.tagline: In Vietnam, the wind doesn't blow. It sucks.

movies.overview: After a chaotic night of rioting in a marginal suburb of Paris, three young friends, Vinz, Hubert and Saïd, wander around unoccupied waiting for news about the state of health of a mutual friend who has been seriously injured when confronting the police.
movies.title: La Haine
movies.tagline: How far you fall doesn't matter, it's how you land…

movies.overview: Blonde Betty Elms has only just arrived in Hollywood to become a movie star when she meets an enigmatic brunette with amnesia. Meanwhile, as the two set off to solve the second woman's identity, filmmaker Adam Kesher runs into ominous trouble while casting his latest project.
movies.title: Mulholland Drive
movies.tagline: A love story in the city of dreams.

movies.overview: After completing jail time for beating up a man who tried to seduce his mentally-handicapped teenage daughter, the Butcher wants to start life anew. He institutionalizes his daughter and moves to the Lille suburbs with his mistress, who promises him a new butcher shop. Learning that she lied, the Butcher returns to Paris to find his daughter.
movies.title: I Stand Alone
movies.tagline: In the bowels of France.

movies.overview: When Ann, husband George, and son Georgie arrive at their holiday home they are visited by a pair of polite and seemingly pleasant young men. Armed with deceptively sweet smiles and some golf clubs, they proceed to terrorize and torture the tight-knit clan, giving them until the next day to survive.
movies.title: Funny Games
movies.tagline: You must admit, you brought this on yourself.

movies.overview: A tormented jazz musician finds himself lost in an enigmatic story involving murder, surveillance, gangsters, doppelgängers, and an impossible transformation inside a prison cell.
movies.title: Lost Highway
movies.tagline: "TWO THUMBS DOWN!" TWO MORE GREAT REASONS TO SEE...

movies.overview: When a young couple goes to a remote wooded lake for a romantic getaway, their quiet weekend is shattered by an aggressive group of local kids. Rowdiness quickly turns to rage as the teens terrorize the couple in unimaginable ways, and a weekend outing becomes a bloody battle for survival.
movies.title: Eden Lake
movies.tagline: A weekend by the lake, with views to die for.

movies.overview: When Seth Brundle makes a huge scientific and technological breakthrough in teleportation, he decides to test it on himself. Unbeknownst to him, a common housefly manages to get inside the device and the two become one.
movies.title: The Fly
movies.tagline: Be afraid. Be very afraid.

movies.overview: A woman on the run from the mob is reluctantly accepted in a small Colorado community in exchange for labor, but when a search visits the town, she learns that their support has a price.
movies.title: Dogville
movies.tagline: A quiet little town not far from here.

movies.overview: A young schoolteacher descends into personal moral degradation after finding himself stranded in a brutal, menacing town in outback Australia.
movies.title: Wake in Fright
movies.tagline: Have a drink, mate? Have a fight, mate? Have some dust and sweat, mate? There's nothing else out here.

movies.overview: A deaf man and his girlfriend resort to desperate measures in order to fund a kidney transplant for his sister. Things go horribly wrong, and the situation spirals rapidly into a cycle of violence and revenge.
movies.title: Sympathy for Mr. Vengeance
movies.tagline: Revenge was never this sweet.

movies.overview: A young woman’s quest for revenge against the people who kidnapped and tortured her as a child leads her and her best friend, also a victim of child abuse, on a terrifying journey into a living hell of depravity.
movies.title: Martyrs
movies.tagline: They haven't finished being alive.

movies.original_title: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith
movies.overview: When the sinister Sith unveil a thousand-year-old plot to rule the galaxy, the Republic crumbles and from its ashes rises the evil Galactic Empire. Jedi hero Anakin Skywalker must choose a side.
movies.title: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith
movies.tagline: Every story has a hero. Every hero has a destiny. Every saga has an end.

movies.overview: Kyung-chul is a dangerous psychopath who kills for pleasure. Soo-hyeon, a top-secret agent, decides to track down the murderer himself. He promises himself that he will do everything in his power to take vengeance against the killer, even if it means that he must become a monster himself.
movies.title: I Saw the Devil
movies.tagline: Abandon all compassion.

movies.overview: A quiet and inconspicuous man rents an apartment in Paris where he finds himself drawn into a rabbit hole of dangerous paranoia.
movies.title: The Tenant
movies.tagline: Apartment for rent: Quiet building. Furnished. 2 rooms. Previous tenant committed suicide.

movies.overview: When a dance troupe is lured to an empty school, a bowl of drug-laced sangria causes their jubilant rehearsal to descend into a dark and explosive nightmare as they try to survive the night—and find who's responsible—before it's too late.
movies.title: Climax
movies.tagline: Birth and death are extraordinary experiences. Life is a fleeting pleasure.

movies.original_title: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
movies.overview: A petty criminal fakes insanity to serve his sentence in a mental ward rather than prison. He soon finds himself as a leader to the other patients—and an enemy to the cruel, domineering nurse who runs the ward.
movies.title: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
movies.tagline: In this clean, orderly, disciplined world, who needs guys like McMurphy? Everybody.

movies.overview: Tonny is released from prison - again. This time he has his mind set on changing his broken down life, but that is easier said than done.
movies.title: Pusher II
movies.tagline: With blood on my hands.

movies.overview: Beautiful young manicurist Carole suffers from androphobia (the pathological fear of interaction with men). When her sister and roommate, Helen, leaves their London flat to go on an Italian holiday with her married boyfriend, Carole withdraws into her apartment. She begins to experience frightful hallucinations, her fear gradually mutating into madness.
movies.title: Repulsion
movies.tagline: The nightmare world of a virgin's dreams becomes the screen's shocking reality!

movies.overview: Rising pop star Mima quits singing to pursue a career as an actress. After she takes up a role on a popular detective show, her handlers and collaborators begin turning up murdered. Harboring feelings of guilt and haunted by visions of her former self, Mima's reality and fantasy meld into a frenzied paranoia.
movies.title: Perfect Blue
movies.tagline: "excuse me... who are you?"

movies.overview: Desperate to escape his mind-numbing routine, uptown Manhattan office worker Paul Hackett ventures downtown for a hookup with a mystery woman.
movies.title: After Hours
movies.tagline: When it's after midnight in New York City, you don't have to look for love, laughter and trouble. They'll all find you!

movies.overview: In Las Vegas, two best friends--a casino executive and a Mafia enforcer--compete for a gambling empire and a fast-living, fast-loving socialite.
movies.title: Casino
movies.tagline: No one stays at the top forever.

movies.overview: Free after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld.
movies.title: Carlito's Way
movies.tagline: He's got a good future if he can live past next week.

movies.overview: In honor of his birthday, San Francisco banker Nicholas Van Orton, a financial genius and a cold-hearted loner, receives an unusual present from his younger brother, Conrad: a gift certificate to play a unique kind of game. In nary a nanosecond, Nicholas finds himself consumed by a dangerous set of ever-changing rules, unable to distinguish where the charade ends and reality begins.
movies.title: The Game
movies.tagline: What do you get for the man who has everything...?

movies.overview: Derek Vineyard is paroled after serving 3 years in prison for killing two African-American men. Through his brother, Danny Vineyard's narration, we learn that before going to prison, Derek was a skinhead and the leader of a violent white supremacist gang that committed acts of racial crime throughout L.A. and his actions greatly influenced Danny. Reformed and fresh out of prison, Derek severs contact with the gang and becomes determined to keep Danny from going down the same violent path as he did.
movies.title: American History X
movies.tagline: Some legacies must end.

movies.overview: A young couple living in a Connecticut suburb during the mid-1950s struggle to come to terms with their personal problems while trying to raise their two children. Based on a novel by Richard Yates.
movies.title: Revolutionary Road
movies.tagline: How do you break free without breaking apart?

movies.overview: A couple's relationship is tested when uninvited guests arrive at their home, disrupting their tranquil existence.
movies.title: mother!
movies.tagline: Seeing is believing.

movies.overview: Several ordinary high school students go through their daily routine as two others prepare for something more malevolent.
movies.title: Elephant
movies.tagline: An ordinary high school day. Except that it's not.

movies.overview: A school teacher discusses types of government with his class. His students find it too boring to repeatedly go over national socialism and believe that dictatorship cannot be established in modern Germany. He starts an experiment to show how easily the masses can become manipulated.
movies.title: The Wave
movies.tagline: Their teacher became their leader. His students became his soldiers.

movies.overview: After denying a woman the extension she needs to keep her home, loan officer Christine Brown sees her once-promising life take a startling turn for the worse. Christine is convinced she's been cursed by a Gypsy, but her boyfriend is skeptical. Her only hope seems to lie in a psychic who claims he can help her lift the curse and keep her soul from being dragged straight to hell.
movies.title: Drag Me to Hell
movies.tagline: Christine Brown has a good job, a great boyfriend, and a bright future. But in three days, she's going to hell.

movies.overview: Taking a break from their dreary lives, close friends Thelma and Louise embark on a short weekend trip that ends in unforeseen incriminating circumstances. As fugitives, both women rediscover the strength of their bond and their newfound resilience.
movies.title: Thelma & Louise
movies.tagline: Somebody said get a life...so they did.

movies.overview: Three childhood friends from the slums of Hong Kong flee to war-time Saigon after accidentally murdering a gang leader, but their troubles only escalate.
movies.title: Bullet in the Head
movies.tagline: Once The Best of Friends, Now The Worst of... Enemies!

movies.overview: David Sumner, a mild-mannered academic from the United States, marries Amy, an Englishwoman. In order to escape a hectic stateside lifestyle, David and his wife relocate to the small town in rural Cornwall where Amy was raised. There, David is ostracized by the brutish men of the village, including Amy's old flame, Charlie. Eventually the taunts escalate.
movies.title: Straw Dogs
movies.tagline: In the Face of Every Coward Burns a Straw Dog.

movies.original_title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me
movies.overview: In the questionable town of Deer Meadow, Washington, FBI Agent Desmond inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the more cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate.
movies.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me
movies.tagline: In a town like Twin Peaks, no one is innocent.

movies.overview: After kidnapping a father and his two kids, the Gecko brothers head south to a seedy Mexican bar to hide out in safety, unaware of its notorious vampire clientele.
movies.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
movies.tagline: One night is all that stands between them and freedom. But it's going to be one hell of a night.

movies.overview: Lester Burnham, a depressed suburban father in a mid-life crisis, decides to turn his hectic life around after developing an infatuation with his daughter's attractive friend.
movies.title: American Beauty
movies.tagline: ... look closer

movies.overview: Jerry, a small-town Minnesota car salesman is bursting at the seams with debt... but he's got a plan. He's going to hire two thugs to kidnap his wife in a scheme to collect a hefty ransom from his wealthy father-in-law. It's going to be a snap and nobody's going to get hurt... until people start dying. Enter Police Chief Marge, a coffee-drinking, parka-wearing - and extremely pregnant - investigator who'll stop at nothing to get her man. And if you think her small-time investigative skills will give the crooks a run for their ransom... you betcha!
movies.title: Fargo
movies.tagline: A homespun murder story.

movies.overview: Brandon, a thirty-something man living in New York, eludes intimacy with women but feeds his deepest desires with a compulsive addiction to sex. When his younger sister temporarily moves into his apartment, stirring up bitter memories of their shared painful past, Brandon's life, like his fragile mind, gets out of control.
movies.title: Shame

movies.overview: Low-level bureaucrat Sam Lowry escapes the monotony of his day-to-day life through a recurring daydream of himself as a virtuous hero saving a beautiful damsel. Investigating a case that led to the wrongful arrest and eventual death of an innocent man instead of wanted terrorist Harry Tuttle, he meets the woman from his daydream, and in trying to help her gets caught in a web of mistaken identities, mindless bureaucracy and lies.
movies.title: Brazil
movies.tagline: It's only a state of mind.

movies.overview: The lives of three men who were childhood friends are shattered when one of them suffers a family tragedy.
movies.title: Mystic River
movies.tagline: We bury our sins, we wash them clean.

movies.overview: After an accident, acclaimed novelist Paul Sheldon is rescued by a nurse who claims to be his biggest fan.  Her obsession takes a dark turn when she holds him captive in her remote Colorado home and forces him to write back to life the popular literary character he killed off.
movies.title: Misery
movies.tagline: Paul Sheldon used to write for a living. Now, he’s writing to stay alive.

movies.overview: A biopic depicting the life of filmmaker and aviation pioneer Howard Hughes from 1927 to 1947, during which time he became a successful film producer and an aviation magnate, while simultaneously growing more unstable due to severe obsessive-compulsive disorder.
movies.title: The Aviator
movies.tagline: Some men dream the future. He built it.

movies.overview: The true story of mountain climber Aron Ralston's remarkable adventure to save himself after a fallen boulder crashes on his arm and traps him in an isolated canyon in Utah.
movies.title: 127 Hours
movies.tagline: Every second counts.

movies.overview: In Montauban in 1944, Julien Dandieu is a surgeon in the local hospital. Frightened by the German army entering Montauban, he asks his friend Francois to drive his wife and his daughter in the back country village where Julien has an old castle. One week later, Julien decides to meet them for the week end, but the Germans are already occupying the village.
movies.title: The Old Gun

movies.overview: A teenage hustler and a young man obsessed with alien abductions cross paths, together discovering a horrible, liberating truth.
movies.title: Mysterious Skin
movies.tagline: Two boys. One can't remember. The other can't forget.

movies.overview: Julian, who runs a Thai boxing club as a front organization for his family's drug smuggling operation, is forced by his mother Crystal to find and kill the individual responsible for his brother's recent death.
movies.title: Only God Forgives
movies.tagline: Time to meet the Devil.

movies.overview: A television reporter and cameraman follow emergency workers into a dark apartment building and are quickly locked inside with something terrifying.
movies.title: [REC]
movies.tagline: Experience fear.

movies.overview: Four men from different parts of the globe, all hiding from their pasts in the same remote South American town, agree to risk their lives transporting several cases of dynamite (which is so old that it is dripping unstable nitroglycerin) across dangerous jungle terrain.
movies.title: Sorcerer
movies.tagline: Four men...outlaws thrown together by fate...share a fantastic adventure and risk the only thing they have left to lose.

movies.overview: Joong-ho is a dirty detective turned pimp, who's in financial trouble as several of his girls have recently disappeared without clearing their debts. While trying to track them down, he finds a clue that the vanished girls were all called up by the same client, whom one of his girls is meeting with right now.
movies.title: The Chaser
movies.tagline: The hunter and the hunted, the ultimate chase begins.

movies.overview: In April of 1945, Germany stands at the brink of defeat with the Russian Army closing in from the east and the Allied Expeditionary Force attacking from the west. In Berlin, capital of the Third Reich, Adolf Hitler proclaims that Germany will still achieve victory and orders his generals and advisers to fight to the last man. When the end finally does come, and Hitler lies dead by his own hand, what is left of his military must find a way to end the killing that is the Battle of Berlin, and lay down their arms in surrender.
movies.title: Downfall
movies.tagline: April 1945, a nation awaits its... Downfall

movies.overview: This psychedelic tour of life after death is seen entirely from the point of view of Oscar, a young American drug dealer and addict living in Tokyo with his prostitute sister, Linda. When Oscar is killed by police during a bust gone bad, his spirit journeys from the past -- where he sees his parents before their deaths -- to the present -- where he witnesses his own autopsy -- and then to the future, where he looks out for his sister from beyond the grave.
movies.title: Enter the Void

movies.overview: The loss of their young daughter threatens to destroy the love and faith of two married musicians.
movies.title: The Broken Circle Breakdown

movies.overview: When 13-year-old Tracy befriends Evie, the most popular girl in school, her life is turned upside down as Evie introduces her to a world of sex, drugs, and money. But it isn’t long before Tracy’s new lifestyle begins to take a heavy toll on her and her family.
movies.title: Thirteen
movies.tagline: It's happening so fast.

movies.overview: Milo is aging, he is planning his daughter's 25th birthday, and his shipment of heroin turns out to be 10,000 pills of ecstasy. When Milo tries to sell the pills anyway, all Hell breaks loose and his only chance is to ask for help from his ex-henchman and old friend Radovan.
movies.title: Pusher III
movies.tagline: I'm the angel of death.

movies.overview: In a small, conservative Scottish village, an oilman is paralyzed in an accident. His wife, who prayed for his return, feels guilty; even more, when he urges her to have sex with another.
movies.title: Breaking the Waves
movies.tagline: Love is a mighty power.

movies.overview: Retired porn star Milos leads a normal family life trying to make ends meet. Presented with the opportunity of a lifetime to financially support his family for the rest of their lives, Milos must participate in one last mysterious film. From then on, Milos is drawn into a maelstrom of unbelievable cruelty and mayhem.
movies.title: A Serbian Film
movies.tagline: Not all films have a happy ending

movies.overview: A troubled rock star descends into madness in the midst of his physical and social isolation from everyone.
movies.title: Pink Floyd: The Wall
movies.tagline: The memories. The madness. The music... The movie.
